newsitem.title: UK: India buys Dubai, Qua Iboe in June tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: India buys Dubai, Qua Iboe in June tender - trade.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought at least two cargoes of Dubai crude and two Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs) of Nigerian Qua Iboe in its tender for June-loading crude, traders said on Friday.
IOC took one Dubai cargo from oil major BP at first half month quotes evens and one or possibly two at first half month quotes evens and minus two cents from trader Phibro, they said.
In addition, IOC bought two VLCCs of Qua Iboe from U.S. major Mobil. Pricing details were not available.
Details of the tender award could not be immediately confirmed with the successful bidders.
In its May tender, India bought Egyptian Suez Blend and Nigerian Qua Iboe, ignoring four Dubai offers.
